scopeNote: Budget-capped to the 5 assigned F1 re-tests (D1-001, D1-003, journal balance guard, invoice lifecycle, D4-003) plus authz/FE cross-checks. NOT an exhaustive CRUD sweep; SKIP entries below state the reason.

readOne.note: GET /:id returns full invoice incl. lineItems, receipts, customer.

update.note: No route exists. Controller declares only GET /, GET /:id, POST /, POST /:id/post, POST /:id/cancel. PATCH and PUT both return 404 'Cannot PATCH/PUT /v1/finance/sales-invoices/:id'. See F2-FIN-009.

delete.note: No DELETE route; returns 404. No orphaned journal lines as a consequence, because no invoice in this box ever produced a journal (F2-FIN-001). See F2-FIN-009.

entities.validationNote: POST with a customerId that does not exist returns 404 with the field named: 'Customer <id> not found'. lineItems: [] returns 400 'Sales invoice must have at least one line item'.
entities.duplicateNote: No unique-constraint probe run; invoiceNumber is derived from a count() and would race, but the sequence is a generated key, not user input, so a duplicate-code test is not meaningful for this entity.
entities.referentialNote: PREREQUISITE UNREACHABLE: there is no API path that creates a Customer. POST /v1/master/customers writes to public.sales_leads, and the returned id is then rejected by the invoice endpoint with 404 'Customer ... not found'. See F2-FIN-003.
entities.authzNote: Non-admin token (nisa@dreamlab.com, role MARKETING) -> HTTP 403 on GET /v1/finance/sales-invoices. No token -> 401. Class-level @Roles(SUPER_ADMIN, ADMIN, FINANCE, DIRECTOR, HEAD_OPS) with JwtAuthGuard + RolesGuard.
entities.postNote: TEST 1. With the seeded COA (no account 4001) POST /:id/post returns 201 and creates ZERO journal entries. With a 4001 account present it returns 400 JOURNAL_UNBALANCED 'Debit: 111000000, Credit: 100000000'. See F2-FIN-001, F2-FIN-004.
entities.cancelNote: POST /:id/cancel returns 200 and sets cancelledAt while leaving postedAt set; no journal is read, created or reversed. See F2-FIN-007.

create.note: POST /v1/finance/journals with balanced lines (1201 Dr 50,000,000 / 4101 Cr 50,000,000) -> HTTP 201, journal 213fa7a5-cd85-478e-a3e9-58ee88def6fd persisted with both lines. NOTE: this route also enforces 'Proof of payment (attachment) is mandatory for disbursements/expenses' and rejects a balanced journal without attachmentUrls.

readList.note: GET /v1/finance/journals and GET /v1/finance/journal both serve entries; trial-balance at GET /v1/finance/reports/trial-balance reconciles exactly against journal_lines.

readOne.note: Not exercised; budget cap. Reverse response returns the full entry with its lines, which incidentally confirmed the read shape.

update.note: No PATCH/PUT route observed on the journals controller.

delete.note: No DELETE route observed. Journal immutability is a defensible accounting design, but no delete route and no reversal-only rule is enforced at the route level.

entities.validationNote: Date, description, and per-line debit/credit are validated; a balanced journal without attachmentUrls is rejected with a message naming the missing proof.
entities.duplicateNote: reference is optional and not unique; duplicate-reference behaviour not probed.
entities.referentialNote: Posting the same sales invoice twice is blocked at the business layer with 400 'Sales invoice already posted.' and journal_entries is unchanged - the idempotency guard holds.
entities.authzNote: Non-admin (MARKETING) token -> HTTP 403 on POST /v1/finance/journals. No token -> 401.
entities.balanceGuardNote: TEST 3. POST /v1/finance/journals with Dr 90,000,000 / Cr 50,000,000 -> HTTP 400 'Journal is not balanced. Debit: 90000000, Credit: 50000000 [JOURNAL_UNBALANCED]'. Guard is a client-level Prisma $extends in prisma.service.ts:84-94: 36 journalEntry.create sites, 0 additional PrismaClient instances, 0 raw-SQL journal writes, 0 createMany/upsert, 0 direct journalLine.create. Holds on all paths.
entities.reverseNote: TEST 4e. POST /v1/finance/journals/:id/reverse created a real contra entry REV-F2-AUD-BAL-HTTP with legs genuinely flipped (1201 Cr 50,000,000 / 4101 Dr 50,000,000), original preserved. The pair nets to zero. This is the correct mechanism - the invoice path simply never uses it.

create.note: Lines are created nested with the entry. Schema carries taxAccountId and taxRate columns; the invoice posting path never populates either, which is the mechanism of D1-001.

readList.note: Reconciled independently: sum(debit)=220,000,000 / sum(credit)=200,000,000 against the live trial-balance endpoint, which returned the same 120,000,000/100,000,000 on the pre-reversal set.

update.note: 0 journalEntry.update / updateMany / upsert sites exist in the backend, so no API can mutate a posted line.

delete.note: 0 delete sites. Lines are append-only in practice.

entities.validationNote: Schema allows a line with debit=0 AND credit=0. A 'journal' whose legs are all zero would pass assertJournalBalanced (0===0) and be accepted. Not exploited here, but the guard tests equality, not that every line carries an amount.
entities.duplicateNote: Not meaningful for lines; they are positionally scoped to their journal.
entities.referentialNote: F2-FIN-006: a balance sheet called without the date query parameter omits every journal written on the current day. Measured: report generated 2026-10-01T05:48:57Z returned assets.total=0 while journal_lines held a 50,000,000 same-day receivable; the same call with ?date=2026-12-31 returned 120,000,000. journal_entries.date is timestamp without time zone, DB session TZ is Asia/Bangkok (UTC+7), and the controllers default the cutoff to new Date().
entities.authzNote: Inherited from the parent journal route; non-admin -> 403.

create.note: TEST blocker F2-FIN-003. POST /v1/master/customers returned 200 with a UUID, but the body carries SalesLead fields (clientName, brandCode, source, productInterest, estimatedValue, status=NEW_LEAD, lostReason, picId) while public.customers has (id, code, name, brand, contactPerson, email, phone, address, npwp, creditLimit, paymentTerms, isActive, notes). A full scan of every UUID-keyed table in audit_f2_finance located the returned id in exactly one place: public.sales_leads. public.customers stayed at 0 rows. There is no API path that creates a Customer.

entities.swallowBehaviourNote: TEST 5. GET /v1/executive/metrics with the revenue query forced to throw (financial_summary_ledger.nominalValue renamed) returned HTTP 200 with revenue.mtd silently 777000000 -> 0 while pipeline (3), production (1) and cashflow (90,000,000) kept their real values. crossCutting.authzDetail: Non-admin (MARKETING) token -> 403 on finance/journals, finance/reports/balance-sheet, executive/metrics, finance/sales-invoices. No token -> 401. Note: @Roles is applied at CLASS level on SalesInvoicesController, not per method.
crossCutting.D3-011_rolesGuardFailOpen: CONFIRMED at code level, not exercised against a live route. backend/src/modules/auth/roles.guard.ts:33-35 - `if (!requiredRoles || requiredRoles.length === 0) { return true; }` returns allow for any route lacking @Roles. Every finance route exercised in this audit carried class-level @Roles, so no exposed finance route was found. Finding the reachable instance is a separate sweep.
crossCutting.D3-012_singleGlobalGuard: NOT TESTED - out of the 5 assigned tests.
crossCutting.boxIsolation: WEAK. audit_f2_finance contains seven schemas: public plus audit_f2_finance, audit_f2_master, audit_f2_warehouse, audit_f2_production, audit_f2_crm, audit_f2_hr. Every box database holds a full copy of every agent's schema, so the per-agent database isolation asserted in F2-PROTOCOL section 2 is nominal, not enforced. The application only ever reads public, so this audit's numbers are uncontaminated, but the boxes are not separated in the way the protocol describes.

feBeContract.detail: Read-only spot check per F2-PROTOCOL section 7. The invoice create DTO requires customerId + dueDate + lineItems[itemCode,itemName,qty,unit,price,discount]; the BE computes tax itself and the client sends no tax field, so there is no FE/BE tax disagreement. The one FE-BE break found was the Customer id mismatch (F2-FIN-003), where a CustomerSelect writing a sales_leads id feeds an invoice endpoint that resolves public.customers. Full FE payload comparison was not performed - budget cap.

summary.note: passed + failed + skipped exceeds `checks` because some cells carry a per-op breakdown; `checks` counts the distinct protocol checks actually run.
